title: Judge c48_long on all 26 stage 2 cases in the surrogate, and make tilt a stand-and-stop limit
summary: The surrogate evaluator ran the unchanged c48_long checkpoint through the 26 stage2_flat cases with the new runner and judge: 21 fixed commands and the five routes with the waypoint follower driving from the true pose. Every route arrives: the body ends 58 to 64 mm from its last goal and stays there for 20 s, inside the 0.12 m tolerance, so the stop row's measurement is now taken in the surrogate. Three cases pass everything: stand, the 0.05 m/s backward walk and the backward route. Drift exceeds 0.1 m on 7 of 8 walks at 0.05 m/s and 6 of 8 at 0.025 m/s; the native open-loop numbers agree. Read over whole trials, tilt exceeded 1.7 degrees on 22 of 26 cases at 2.0 to 2.4 degrees while moving, and the 2 November native campaign shows the same 1.7 to 2.4 on 7 of 13 probes. The limit came from the scorer's stop-tail bound and had never been applied to walking, so the program lead made it a stand-and-stop limit: the judge reads tilt under a zero command from the settle after each stop to the end of the trial, and the requirements file says so. Under that rule tilt passes on 24 of 26 cases; after the 0.05 m/s walks at 270 and 315 degrees the body settles at up to 1.81 degrees, so the controller still fails tilt by 0.1 degree on two stops. The surrogate clamps motor torque at the rating, so its torque reading is the clamp, not a measurement. The run exposed two defects: float32 commands at 0.05 m/s on a diagonal read as 0.0500000023 and escaped the drift speed test, so four walks were never judged for drift, fixed with a relative tolerance and a test; and the surrogate evaluator read a pre-migration checkpoint record without translating its class names, fixed by applying the native loader's translation. The accepted controller's judged rows carry the new numbers; its acceptance text is unchanged. Raw traces, 928 MB, stay on the lead's machine with their hashes in the asset.
next: Run the Spark renewal campaign on the 26 cases when the GPU is free; then the owner-file work: roadmap done lines, mission sentence, Stage 2 done decision, owner-file check in the site checker, ARCHITECTURE rewrite.
reason: The accepted controller's judged rows change: the stop tolerance is now measured on the file's routes, tilt becomes a stand-and-stop limit and fails on two stops by 0.1 degree, and drift at 0.025 m/s is recorded. The judge gains a float32 tolerance, which changes its hash. The checkpoint, the approved robot and roadmap markers remain unchanged.
